thread:
Dmitri: Kicking off staged rollout v3.5.7 -> 7% on /generate. Change window 2026-06-12 20:00 UTC. Deploybot will post manifest.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: release=v3.5.7 rollout=staged traffic=7% route=/generate id=r-1777771234
```
deployctl start --id r-1777771234 --release v3.5.7 --canary 7 --route /generate
```

SRE-bot: Baseline checks active: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, mem RSS, kv-cache hitrate, tokenization_err. Alerts to follow.

Leah: Obs ask: also track model-init latency and first-token latency for short prompts. Dash: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1777771234

Tom: Pinned runtime flags: preload_kv=true, kv_limit=10G for canary. Release notes linked.

deploy-bot: Canary applied. State=HEALTHY. Monitoring window 10m.

monitor-bot: SIGNAL r-1777771234: p95 +28ms (3m), 5xx=0.06%, kv-cache miss +4%. No allocation errors.

Leah: All good so far. Continue to 15m probe.

monitor-bot: ALERT r-1777771234: mem RSS spike on infra-e-02: +40% (2m). Top log: "kvcache: eviction pressure". Link: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/r-1777771234

SRE-bot: Thresholds: stop if 5xx >0.5% for 3m OR p95 delta >120ms for 5m OR kv-cache miss >10% OR any "malloc failed"/"segfault" logs. Current mem spike is concerning.

Tom: Recommend reduce traffic to 3% and extend probe to gather heap profiles unless SRE wants immediate stop.

Dmitri: Let's shrink to 3% and probe 8m. If mem spike persists or we see allocation failures -> stop. Approve shrink?

SRE-bot: Approve shrink and continue observational probe. Manual stop stand-by.

deploy-bot: Updating rollout r-1777771234 -> traffic=3%
```
deployctl update --id r-1777771234 --traffic 3
```

monitor-bot: SIGNAL r-1777771234: kv-cache miss = 11% (4m), mem RSS still high on infra-e-02, logs show "malloc failed: cannot allocate memory".

Leah: That's above kv threshold and we have allocation failures. Manual STOP requested by obs. Prepare rollback to v3.5.6, collect heap & kv dumps.

deploy-bot: STOP requested by @Leah. Executing rollback steps:
```
route set /generate --version=3.5.6
scale deployment llm-gen-v3.5.7 --replicas=0
collect-artifacts --id r-1777771234 --artifacts=heap-dump,kvcache-dump
```

Dmitri: Confirmed rollback. Opening ticket R-8822 for memory/kv regression. Owners: @Tom, @Leah. Quick triage 2026-06-12 20:30 UTC.

Tom: Updating release notes: "Canary v3.5.7 rolled back due to kv-cache memory pressure and allocation failures. Reverted to v3.5.6." Tagging: rollback, kvcache, memory.

SRE-bot: Rollback complete. Route now -> v3.5.6. Canary pool drained. State=ROLLED_BACK.

Leah: I'll attach TTL'd heap snapshots and eviction metrics before the sync. Thanks for fast action. :raised_hands:
